design_philosophy.description: A 'Super App' mobile-first hosting dashboard replacing traditional cPanel UI with native quick actions, while maintaining SSO links and an escape hatch for power users.
design_philosophy.rounding: rounded-2xl for major surfaces, rounded-xl for interactive elements
design_philosophy.spacing: Generous whitespace (p-6, p-8) to reduce cognitive load

rules.headings: Manrope with tracking-tight. Avoid Inter for headings.
rules.text_color: Use slate-800 (#1e293b) for primary text, slate-500 (#64748b) for secondary.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft ambient shadows. shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid slate-200 (border-slate-200) to define card edges cleanly.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (or lucide-react) strictly in #166db4 (primary color) or slate-500 depending on state.

mobile.navigation: Fixed Bottom Bar (bottom-0, w-full, h-16 or h-20, bg-white, border-t border-slate-100).
mobile.fab: Central Floating Action Button (+), elevated above bottom bar (-translate-y-6), bg-[#166db4], shadow-lg, rounded-full.
mobile.dashboard_services: Horizontal swipeable carousel. overflow-x-auto, snap-x, snap-mandatory, hide scrollbar. Cards take 85vw.
mobile.quick_actions_panel: Bottom Sheet (slide up modal) triggered by FAB. Contains a 2-column grid of quick actions.

desktop.navigation: Ramping Left Sidebar (w-64, hidden on mobile).
desktop.top_header: Includes Quick Actions dropdown (+ button), Profile, Wallet summary.

wallet_card.style: Gradient bg from primary to primary-dark or solid white with primary text. Displays greeting and balance.

service_card.content: Domain name, Status badge (Active/Suspended), Disk usage progress bar (h-2, rounded-full, bg-slate-100, indicator bg-primary).

quick_action_button.style: Flex column, centered, rounded-xl p-4 bg-slate-50 hover:bg-primary/5, text-primary. Icon + Label.

unpaid_alert.style: Banner/Card with bg-amber-50, border border-amber-200, text-amber-800. Prominent 'Pay Now' button.

cpanel_escape_hatch.style: Outline button (border-slate-300 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50), subtle placement to not distract from native UI.

motion.bottom_sheet: Slide up from bottom (Framer Motion: initial {y: '100%'}, animate {y: 0}).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST construct the UI to strictly differentiate mobile and desktop layouts (using standard Tailwind sm/md/lg breakpoints).
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for elements that scroll over content.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='fab-button').
Ensure 'Swipeable services carousel' uses native CSS snap points for mobile.
Mock the SSO redirects (File Manager, phpMyAdmin) and cPanel Escape Hatch with a simple Toast notification or fake loading state rather than real navigation.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Left-align text content, center-align icons in grid blocks where appropriate.
Since the project uses .js files, ensure component code is provided in Javascript not Typescript.
